service.method: SELECT TITLE_CD AS GRADECODE , TITLE_NM AS GRADENAME , TITLE_E_NM AS GRADENAMEEN , COM_CD AS COMCODE , COM_NM AS COMNAME , '0' AS SORT_SEQ FROM [#GW_DATABASE#].[dbo].[DZZV_BASE_TITLE] WHERE TITLE_CD IS NOT NULL AND TITLE_NM IS NOT NULL AND COM_CD IS NOT NULL GROUP BY TITLE_CD, TITLE_NM, TITLE_E_NM , COM_CD, COM_NM
SELECT CODE FROM SCODE WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND TYPE = 'UX049' AND CODE = ${GRADECODE} AND LANGUAGE = 'KO'
